title: WFM: Wiki Foundation Model for Complex Agentic Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.18182v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-world agents fundamentally require persistent non-parametric knowledge for dynamic reasoning, i.e., long-term memory and retrieval-augmented generation. While graphs have shown reliable advantages in providing structured evidence, the sparse graph representations naturally restrict machine readability and semantic density required for complex agentic workflows. Driven by this limitation, the entire industry is witnessing a paradigm shift from traditional sparse graphs to LLM Wiki, an agent-native knowledge representation that couples dense document contexts with markdown files containing multi-layered topological linkages. However, parameterizing such rich semantics is challenging to encode dense textual contexts using traditional sparse graph embeddings. translated_title: WFM：面向复杂智能体推理的维基基础模型
translated_abstract: 真实世界的智能体从根本上需要持久化的非参数化知识来支持动态推理，即长期记忆与检索增强生成。虽然图在提供结构化证据方面已展现出可靠的优势，但稀疏的图表示天然地限制了复杂智能体工作流所需的机器可读性与语义密度。受这一局限的驱动，整个行业正在见证一场从传统稀疏图到LLM维基（LLM Wiki）的范式转变——LLM维基是一种智能体原生的知识表示方式，它将密集的文档上下文与包含多层拓扑链接的markdown文件相结合。然而，对如此丰富的语义进行参数化极具挑战性，因为传统的稀疏图嵌入难以编码密集的文本上下文；此外，使用现有的图编码器来学习LLM维基可能会造成过高的分布式系统开销，阻碍其在大规模商业场景中的部署。为此，我们提...（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 针对智能体知识表示从传统稀疏图向LLM维基演进的趋势，该论文提出维基基础模型（WFM），旨在解决密集文本语义难以用传统稀疏图嵌入参数化、以及现有图编码器分布式系统开销过高难以规模化部署的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes WFM (Wiki Foundation Model) for complex agentic reasoning, addressing the challenges of parameterizing dense textual semantics in agent-native LLM Wiki representations and the prohibitive distributed system overheads of existing graph encoders.
